description: Source code for a command-line utility that provides a behave shell interface, including classes for command execution and result handling, as well as helper functions for subprocess management and glob pattern expansion.

classes.name: CommandResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of a subprocess command, including output, return code, and error messages.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Helper class to run subprocess commands, manage command maps, preprocess and postprocess commands, and handle execution details.

methods.name: get_behave_cmd
methods.description: Determines the path to the behave executable based on the search path.

methods.name: CommandResult.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a CommandResult object with command details and output.

methods.name: CommandResult.output
methods.description: Returns combined stdout and stderr output.

methods.name: CommandResult.failed
methods.description: Indicates if the command execution failed based on return code.

methods.name: CommandResult.clear
methods.description: Resets the CommandResult object to initial state.

methods.name: Command.run
methods.description: Executes a command as a subprocess, collects output and return code, with support for preprocessing and postprocessing.

methods.name: behave
methods.description: Runs the behave command with specified arguments and working directory.
